blocks.text: NEW YORK — Kiyan Anthony grew up sitting courtside at Madison Square Garden watching his father take on Kobe Bryant, LeBron James, Kevin Durant and all of basketball’s biggest stars during a Hall of Fame career in the NBA. “The World’s Most Famous Arena” was practically a second home. But the Syracuse sophomore had never played a game on that hallowed floor himself — until Sunday night against No. 13 St. John’s.
